name: Parabolic SAR stop-and-reverse swing with next-bar SAR stop orders (1% risk)
author: SoftKill21
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: When PSAR is below price (uptrend), place buy-stop at next-bar SAR level to enter long (AF start 0.02, increment 0.02, max 0.2).
entry_short: When PSAR is above price place sell-stop at next-bar SAR.
exit: Exit/reverse when price crosses PSAR (sell-stop at next-bar SAR opens short).
position_sizing: Risk 1% of balance per trade based on distance to SAR stop
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: SAR is hand-coded in script; confirm Wilder AF reset behaviour when porting.
